title: AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: A. AWARD a firm fixed price Contract No. PS140835000 to RailWorks Track Services, LLC, for Phase 1 Preconstruction…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0563, Contract]
[CONSTRUCTION COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer to: 

A.	AWARD a firm fixed price Contract No. PS140835000 to RailWorks Track Services, LLC, for Phase 1 Preconstruction Services of the Construction Manager/General Contractor contract for the A&E Line Interlock Project (Project) in the amount of $1,000,000, subject to the resolution of any properly submitted protest(s), if any;

B.	ESTABLISH a Preconstruction Budget for the Project in an amount of $27,290,000; and

C.	NEGOTIATE and EXECUTE all project-related agreements and modifications within the authorized Preconstruction Budget.
summary: Metro Board awards $1,000,000 contract to RailWorks Track Services for Phase 1 Preconstruction Services of the A&E Line Interlock Project.
